summary: Brookfield Business Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a July 31, 2026 press release reporting second quarter 2026 financial results. The release highlights $1.2 billion of asset sale proceeds year-to-date, including an agreement to sell Multiplex, but provides no deal-specific financial terms, pricing, or structure. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with operational commentary across segments (Industrials, Business Services, Infrastructure Services) and notes a share purchase practice. No board recommendation, advisors, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special-situation event requiring further analysis.
